sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Yes/no questions can use the same basic word order with question intonation. Question words such as ki, mi, *hol*, mit and miért introduce information questions.

Try turning every statement you’ve learned so far into a question just by changing your intonation up at the end, no word-order gymnastics required — Dolgozol? from Dolgozol. is the whole trick. It’s one of the few places where Hungarian is actually easier than English.
